title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.06090v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. translated_title: NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval 任务概述：科学论文中的跨模态声明验证
translated_abstract: 本文概述了 SciClaimEval，这是 NTCIR-19 的一项试点任务，旨在根据科学论文中出现的表格和图形来验证科学声明。我们的数据集将来自机器学习、自然语言处理和医学领域 180 篇论文中的真实声明与其表格和图形的对比版本配对，其中一个版本支持该声明，另一个仅经过最小修改便不再支持。该任务包含两个子任务：判断一条证据是否支持某个声明，以及从两个证据版本中选出支持该声明的那一个。共有 22 支团队注册参与，是 NTCIR-19 各项任务中注册数量最多的，其中 14 支团队提交了 177 个参赛结果。大多数系统基于多模态大语言模型构建，依赖提示工程和多阶段推理，而非针对任务的微调。在第一个子任务上，最佳系统达到了 98.1% 的配对准确率，但所有六个排名最高的系统都依赖于对比配对；表现最好的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文介绍了 NTCIR-19 的 SciClaimEval 试点任务，构建了一个将科学声明与论文表格及图形对比版本配对的跨模态验证数据集，吸引了 22 支团队参与，基于多模态大语言模型的最佳系统达到 98.1% 的配对准确率，但顶尖系统均依赖对比配对信息。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SciClaimEval, a pilot NTCIR-19 task featuring a cross-modal dataset that pairs scientific claims with contrastive versions of their papers' tables and figures, where 22 teams participated and the best multimodal LLM-based systems achieved 98.1% pair accuracy, though all top-ranked systems relied on contrastive pairs.
